per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall complete parts searches in under 15 seconds to avoid disrupting user workflow.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The search for recycled parts shall take no longer than 15 seconds. The search results shall be returned in under 15 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall complete facility lookups in under 8 seconds to ensure smooth user experience during customer interactions.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The search for the preferred repair facility shall take no longer than 8 seconds. The preferred repair facility is returned within 8 seconds'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall generate audit reports in under 10 seconds to allow users to complete tasks without switching contexts.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The recycled parts audit report shall be returned to the user within 10 seconds. The audit report shall be returned within 10 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall confirm save actions within 5 seconds to provide users with confidence that their actions have been successfully saved.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The preferred repair facility ratings shall be saved within 5 seconds. The save shall occur within 5 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall maintain performance with up to 1,500 concurrent users during peak times to ensure smooth operation for all users.

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall provide help functionality in approximately 90% of screens to assist users in completing tasks without external assistance.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The user shall easily locate instructions while using the product. User help can be found within 90% of the system.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall require no more than two days of hands-on, onsite training for 95% of users to become comfortable with the system.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall be easy to learn by Adjusters and Collision Estimators. The product shall be learned with two days onsite training'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall provide warnings before session timeouts and save drafts to prevent loss of unsaved work.
